kind: pre-registered zero-training analysis: Z1 path-overlap interventions on existing grokking-reproduction-v1 weights, plus the readout of the already frozen S1/S2 of path-hop-analysis-v1; no training, no parameter update is kept
freeze_statement: 写于主机sn4622122392，该机没有grokking-reproduction-v1权重，也没有results/path-hop-analysis-v1。冻结时已读：8条运行的原生学习曲线（HF learning.json，下列节点选择只依据它们）；bridge-workspace-v1在700k/1M/1.5M节点的异桥交换与桥分量删除端点（roadmap 2026-10-10重读）；写入目标逐编辑重读；MQuAKE部分逐案例记录预览（ROME 1–1709例、MEMIT 1–1791例）。仓库与HF归档中没有任何Z1干预结果。S1/S2的判读规则写于上述MQuAKE预览之后，因此对S1/S2不是盲写；Z1对其主统计是盲写。 v2: rank-sign correction authorized before select/run output; v1 remains byte-preserved. Historical path-recovery/completion Z1 names denote window masks and state patches, not this fact-selective unit analysis.

execution.host: experiment host with the grokking-reproduction-v1 weights; fixed LM image, docker --context lm-memory, one container per GPU
execution.numerics: eval mode, dropout off, float32 forward with explicit causal softmax attention (no autocast, no SDPA); every intervention is a forward-time edit, parameters are never written
execution.replication_check: fp32 baseline answers are compared with the stored bf16 predictions of the same node on all seven panels; required agreement >= 0.95 on every panel at every node with step >= 16000, and >= 0.99 on test_ii at 1.5M of each run. Below 16000 steps near-tied logits make bf16/fp32 argmax disagreements expected: agreement is reported, and the node stops only below 0.50. A failure stops the run and is kept; it signals a wrong checkpoint/data mapping, not a scientific outcome. (Amended 2026-10-10 before any run, from 'step >= 1000'.)
execution.scoring: answer token only (argmax over the full vocabulary at the answer position equals the true tail). The stop token is not generated; learning.json 'accuracy' also requires the stop token, so all baselines are this batch's own answer accuracy, recomputed at each node.
execution.hashes: sha256 of every checkpoint read, world.npz, panels.npz and the three code files is written to each node output

z1.question: 同一事实f=(b,r2)作单跳查询与作次跳时，是否经过同一组因果必需的参数单元？
z1.component: fact-selective MLP units. Unit u=(unique block j, neuron n). Parameter-level zero ablation of u = zeroing row n of block j's mlp.c_proj weight, implemented as multiplying GELU activation n of block j by 0 at every position of the executions in the chosen scope.
z1.executions: execution e=0..7. Loop 4x2: block e mod 4, round 1 = e 0-3, round 2 = e 4-7. Standard 8: block e.
z1.fact_sample: per run, fixed across that run's nodes: 256 ID facts and 256 OOD facts drawn with seed 20261011 among facts that are the second fact of >= 3 eligible-kind chains. ID f: chains of kind II (first fact ID) that are NOT in this run's training support (train_order[:round(phi*38000)]). OOD f: chains of kind IO. Up to 16 such chains per fact, chosen with the same seed.

selection_on_single_hop_only.margin: logit_t - max_{v != t} logit_v over the full vocabulary, float32
selection_on_single_hop_only.attribution: s_u = +d margin / d g_u at g = 1, where g_u multiplies activation u in all executions and positions (first-order estimate of the margin DROP from zero-ablating u: margin(1) - margin(1-e_u) ~= d margin/d g_u); rank descending
selection_on_single_hop_only.k_star: smallest k in the grid such that zero-ablating the top-k units (scope all) changes the atomic answer away from t; none -> fact 'not localized'

selectivity_controls.same_subject: the other atoms with head b (other relations)
selectivity_controls.same_answer: up to 16 other atoms with tail t (different head), chosen with seed
selectivity_controls.random: 64 random atoms with head != b, one fixed draw per run with seed 20261012

selection_on_single_hop_only.selective: at k_star, among control atoms answered correctly at baseline, retention >= 0.90 separately for same_subject, same_answer and random; a control group that is empty after the baseline filter counts as passed and is flagged
selection_on_single_hop_only.requirement: f answered correctly at baseline. Two-hop outcomes are never used for selection.

two_hop_measure.eligible_query: a sampled chain [h, r1, r2] whose second fact is f, answered correctly (answer token) at baseline, and whose first fact (h, r1)->b is answered correctly as an atomic prompt at baseline
two_hop_measure.T_scope: fraction of eligible queries whose answer is no longer t when S_f (the k_star units) is ablated in that scope
two_hop_measure.R_scope: the same for a random control set: k_star units drawn uniformly without replacement from the same unique blocks with the same per-block counts, excluding S_f; one draw per fact, seed from (20261013, fact index)
two_hop_measure.delta: Delta_scope = mean over selective facts with >= 1 eligible query of (T_scope - R_scope); fact-level bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 20261014, percentile [0.025, 0.975]
descriptive: first-fact atomic retention under S_f (all executions)
same-bridge other-relation retention: up to 4 chains [h, r1, r2'] sharing f's first fact, with r2' != r2, under the round2 (Loop) or all (standard) scope
Loop atomic decomposition: atomic flip of f under S_f in round1 only and round2 only
Standard depth decomposition: T_all for S_f restricted to blocks 0-3 and to blocks 4-7
mean answer-margin change for S_f and for the random control
facts passing only the same_subject and random controls (same_answer ignored), as a secondary population
trained II chains of ID facts, reported apart from untrained ones

primary_nodes.loop: Loop nodes with learning.json test_io >= 0.50 and atomic_ood >= 0.90: phi3.6 1.5M; phi7.2/wd.1 512k, 700k, 1M, 1.5M; phi12.6 512k, 700k, 1M, 1.5M; phi7.2/wd.3 256k, 512k, 700k, 1M, 1.5M (14 nodes)
primary_nodes.standard: standard-8 nodes with learning.json test_ii >= 0.50: phi7.2/wd.1 128k-1.5M (6); phi12.6 16k-1.5M (9); phi7.2/wd.3 64k-1.5M (7) (22 nodes); phi3.6 never reaches 0.50
primary_nodes.power: a node is powered for a fact kind when >= 30 selective facts of that kind have >= 1 eligible query. Majorities are taken over powered primary nodes; if fewer than half of the primary nodes are powered, the corresponding verdict is 'inconclusive'. All other nodes are reported descriptively.

primary_statistic.loop: Delta_round2 for OOD facts (IO chains); round specificity Delta_round1 for OOD facts
primary_statistic.standard: Delta_all for ID facts (untrained II chains)

interpretation.loop_supports: at a majority of powered Loop primary nodes, Delta_round2 >= 0.50 and Delta_round1 <= 0.20: the units necessary for f's single-hop answer are needed for f's second-hop use in round 2 and not in round 1
interpretation.loop_against: at a majority of powered Loop primary nodes, Delta_round2 <= 0.10: IO succeeds but the single-hop necessary units do not carry the second hop. Then path consistency is narrowed to 'parameter sharing changes the write-use kernel', and F3 becomes a descriptive figure
interpretation.standard_separate_copy: at a majority of powered standard primary nodes Delta_all <= 0.10: ID facts' second-hop use does not need the single-hop necessary units (separate upper-layer copy, as in Zhang et al.)
interpretation.standard_shared: at a majority Delta_all >= 0.50: the standard model's second-hop use shares the single-hop units, contrary to the separate-copy account; must be reinterpreted
interpretation.id_facts_in_loop: Delta_round2 / Delta_round1 for ID facts in Loop: secondary, same thresholds, reported but not part of the verdict

fallback_selection.added: 2026-10-11, decided by the user before any Z1 output existed
fallback_selection.purpose: redundant storage can leave the primary top-k set unable to flip the atomic answer ('not localized'); this fallback addresses only that failure
fallback_selection.component: same fact-selective MLP units and zero ablation as the primary design; no attention components
fallback_selection.procedure: iterative attribution on [b, r2]: S starts empty; for each k in k_grid_fallback ascending, recompute s_u = -d margin / d g_u with the units in S zero-ablated (all executions and positions), add the top (k - |S|) units not in S, then zero-ablate S (scope all); k_star_fallback = first k that changes the atomic answer away from t; none -> not localized
fallback_selection.unchanged: fact sample, selectivity controls and the 0.90 threshold, random control units, eligible queries, scopes, T/R/Delta, bootstrap, primary nodes, power rule, majority rule, all interpretation thresholds
fallback_selection.verdict_source: per verdict group, count primary nodes powered under the primary design from selection-stage information only; if at least half are powered the verdict comes from the primary design, otherwise from the fallback design (labelled 'fallback'); if the fallback also leaves fewer than half powered, the verdict is 'inconclusive'; both designs are computed at every node and reported in full

ported_diagnostics_descriptive.source: Zhang et al. 2026 repository zzl-strong/two_hop (scripts 8, 11, 5), ported to ReproductionGPT; the author scripts are read, not executed
ported_diagnostics_descriptive.attention_window_masking: Appendix E: zero the attention weight from the answer position to the subject/bridge position and renormalize, in a window of executed layers centred at each of the 8 executions (window 3: [c-1, c+1]; also window 1). Edges: atomic 1->0 on atomic_id/atomic_ood; two-hop 2->1 and 1->0 on train_ii/test_ii/test_io/test_oi/test_oo. Answer accuracy per centre.
ported_diagnostics_descriptive.layerwise_cosine: Appendix G: for second facts of train_ii (ID) and test_io (OOD) panel chains, cosine between the atomic prompt's token-0 state at boundary i and the mean two-hop bridge-slot (position 1) state at boundary j, and atomic token 1 versus two-hop position 2; boundary 0 is the token embedding without position embedding; 9x9 matrices averaged over facts
ported_diagnostics_descriptive.bridge_patching: Section 4.2: 3000 ID and 3000 OOD tuples (seed 20261015). Target: train_ii panel chain (h, r1, r2 -> t). Position-1 state at the output of execution L replaced by the position-1 state of an atomic prefix [h', r1'] with the same tail b (ID prefix with (h', r1') != (h, r1), or OOD prefix); position-2 state replaced by that of a training chain with the same r2 and a different answer. Success: answer t. L = 1..8.
ported_diagnostics_descriptive.logit_lens: bridge readout accuracy at position 1 after every execution, per two-hop panel

s1_s2_readout.source_contract: configs/path-hop-analysis-v1.json (frozen 2026-10-08; S1/S2 already computed by scripts/analyze_path_hop_position.py)

fields.S1: secondary_prerequisite_subset: coverage, estimate {direct, cot, interaction}, interval, cells

s1_s2_readout.no_recomputation: the readout copies the frozen numbers; it does not re-score, re-group or re-bootstrap

reading.S1_prerequisite_failure: for each editor: if the S1 interaction (M2 within the prerequisite subset) has a 95% interval with low > 0, the full-pool pattern of that editor is read as consistent with prerequisite failure (within the subset the explicit bridge narrows the hop gap). If the interval includes 0 or lies below it, the against pattern persists within the subset and case composition remains the better explanation.
reading.S1_power: if the later group in the prerequisite subset has < 30 cases in either hop stratum, S1 for that editor is reported as underpowered
reading.S2_P4: P4 holds for an editor and stratum when old_answer_retained(later) > old_answer_retained(first); reported per stratum with counts and as the equal-weight mean difference; no interval was frozen for S2, so none is added
reading.preview: once the formal numbers are read, the HF partial-record preview numbers are removed from roadmap and results and replaced by them

outputs.summary: results/zero-training-path-overlap-v2/summary.json: verdicts computed mechanically from the per-node outputs by the analyze step

not_permitted: using two-hop outcomes to select S_f, k_star or facts
changing nodes, thresholds, k grid, controls or scopes after any Z1 output is read
replacing a failed replication check by re-running with a different checkpoint mapping without recording the failure
describing Z1 as independent replications across nodes or runs
re-scoring or re-grouping the path-hop-analysis-v1 outputs in the S1/S2 readout
re-introducing the withdrawn Z2 interventions under another name without a new question
choosing between the primary and fallback designs by anything other than z1.fallback_selection.verdict_source

z2.when: before any run; no Z2 output was ever computed
z2.reason: On the same grokking-reproduction-v1 weights, bridge-workspace-v1 already erased the bridge input-embedding component and swapped it (x1, x2) to another bridge at 700k/1M/1.5M (8 of the 23 planned main nodes); DiscoLoop-style self-decode/true/wrong re-encoding was already run in bridge-reencoding-v1 on the small shared-block models. What remained (same-bridge amplification, earlier nodes, cosine, Stage-1) completes those results without a new question. F4 uses the existing results and the 2026-10-10 re-read.
z2.record: the withdrawn design (closure statistic, 23 main nodes, decision rules) is summarised in docs/roadmap.md §5.0.1; the earlier draft of this file, configs/zero-training-path-format-v1.json, was never committed or run

amendments.when: before any Z1 output existed: the user confirmed that neither the selection-only stage (select) nor run had been executed on any host
amendments.change: added z1.fallback_selection, a pre-specified fallback selection (iterative attribution, k up to 1024, MLP units only) with a fixed verdict-source rule, and the matching not_permitted entry; every primary-design setting is unchanged
amendments.reason: redundantly stored facts can leave the primary design without enough localized facts, so a group verdict would be 'inconclusive'; the fallback is fixed now so that no choice is made after any Z1 output is read (roadmap §5.0.1)

amendments.decided_by: user authorization to execute the recommendation including correction
amendments.when: before any current-contract Z1 selection or intervention result exists; no weights used to decide correction
amendments.change: v2 corrects attribution sign to +d margin/d g ranked descending for both designs; every sample, grid, threshold, control, scope, node and verdict-source rule is inherited unchanged
amendments.reason: a gate decrease by 1 changes margin by -dmargin/dg; the drop is +dmargin/dg. Negative-gradient descending preferentially selects units suppressing the correct answer. Finite-difference semantic regression required.
